about: Proof for the ETL step guide's tick boxes. A box listed here cannot be ticked by hand: it ticks itself when the learner pastes the output of their own run (paste) and/or when their GitHub repository shows the work (github). Numbers come from the repository's seeded generator (seed 42), so a real run prints exactly these. Rules: etl-proof-core.mjs; tests: tools/proof.test.mjs.
